result.one_liner: Meta's Marketing API provides programmatic access to manage and analyze Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

evidence.quote: Meta uses an OAuth permission system where your app needs specific scopes approved, with ads_management (for write access) and ads_read (for read access)
Permissions start at Standard Access (your own assets only). Production use on other accounts needs Advanced Access, which requires App Review and Business Verification
The Meta Ads API uses Graph API endpoints (which is Meta's implementation of GraphQL)

result.notes: Free self-serve signup available but Advanced Access for production use requires app review and business verification. Graph API (GraphQL) with multiple functional pillars: Marketing API, Insights API, and Ad Library API. System User tokens preferred for server-to-server automation.
